title: Simulation Approach of the Asynchronous Machine Module for Students in the Laboratory
content: This paper presents the simulation of the Asynchronous Machine Module, making use of the LabView tool to make the graphical presentation of it, simulating its real behavior at the time of performing the practices, thus allowing the prediction of the state of the Variables of the induction motor according to its operation. With the data obtained from the simulation carried out in Simulink it was possible to observe the ideal behavior of the machine and the realization of the simulation in LabVIEW in order to later take data in a practical way and being able to compare by error percentage having low results.
